sections.heading: FLORIDA COP LIQUOR LICENSES
paragraphs: From start to finish, idea to opening, we’re the best in the industry to help you make it all happen.

If you’re planning on opening a bar or restaurant in Florida determined to sell alcoholic beverages, you will need a Florida COP Liquor License. Florida COP licenses are quota liquor licenses designated as on-premises licenses for the sale of packaged beer, wine and liquor. This means that a Florida COP Liquor license is intended for businesses selling alcohol for consumption on-premises (although businesses with this type of license may also sell alcohol packaged in sealed containers).
There are 5 common types of Florida COP Liquor Licenses, the only difference being determined by the size of the county you’re trying to obtain a license for (and how much they cost as a result):

A 4COP License, 5COP License, 6COP License, 7COP License, 8COP License, are all typically issued for restaurants, bars and nightclubs. Liquor, beer and wine may be sold for on-premises consumption, as well alcoholic beverages packaged and sealed for off-premises consumption.

If you feel that your business requires a Florida COP Liquor License, then you have found the right place! We can help you to obtain a Florida COP Liquor License, no matter which county in Florida your business is in. We can provide both assistance and consultation in applying for a license directly from the FDBPR, as well as assistance in brokering the purchase of your Florida COP Liquor License from a seller on the open market.

Are you interested in selling your Florida COP Liquor License? Our team can assist you there too! We can ensure that we find the best value for your license, while also vetting any interested buyers to ensure that they are qualified under the requirements of the FDBPR.
